cards.name: Patchwork Visor
cards.text: When installed, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Six lenses, none of them matching.

cards.name: Ironclad Will
cards.text: Hacks can't lower your Stability.

cards.name: Feedback Loop
cards.text: +2 Glitch on the target, +3 if it has a mod.
cards.flavor: Turn it up until it screams.

cards.name: Magnetic Grapple
cards.text: +1 Power for each mod attached to it.

cards.name: Shunt Wire
cards.text: +1 Power if the augment it's on has no Glitch.
cards.flavor: Ground it. Then ground it again.

cards.name: Corrosive Emitter
cards.text: Scrap your weakest mod to give the target +4 Glitch.

cards.name: The Red Menace
cards.text: +1 Power for each mod on your other augments.
cards.flavor: The whole rig answers to it.

cards.name: Overdrive Coil
cards.text: Doubles the Power printed on its augment.
cards.flavor: Rated for twice the load. Briefly.

cards.name: Decay Spores
cards.text: The opponent loses 2 Stability.

cards.name: Siphon Tube
cards.text: When attached, the opponent gains 1 Glitch.

cards.name: Toxic Filter
cards.text: When the opponent hacks you, they gain 2 Glitch.

cards.name: Radiation Leak
cards.text: Remove all mods from the target.

cards.name: Hazmat Visor
cards.text: Blocks the next hack played on you.

cards.name: Malignant Code
cards.text: +2 Glitch on the target, and move all hack Glitch from your augments onto it.

cards.name: Half-Life Generator
cards.text: +4 Power at the showdown if the opponent is Compromised.

cards.name: Fission Fist
cards.text: Its Power is never halved when you're Compromised.
cards.flavor: It hits just as hard on fire.

cards.name: Plague Walker
cards.text: Your hacks that add Glitch add 1 more.
cards.flavor: Leaves a trail. Everyone gets sick.

cards.name: Pressurized Struts
cards.text: +1 Power for each of your turns before it was installed.

cards.name: Thruster Pack
cards.text: Only from your 5th turn.

cards.name: Suffocate
cards.text: The target gains no Power from mods.
cards.flavor: Cut the air. Watch it stall.

cards.name: Zero-G Calibration
cards.text: Your torso can hold 3 mods.
cards.flavor: Room to float. Room to build.

cards.name: Airlock Override
cards.text: Target an augment with no mods: it counts 0 Power.

cards.name: Cryo-Sleep Chamber
cards.text: +2 Power for each of your other augments with no Glitch.

cards.name: Kinetic Harpoon
cards.text: When installed, steals the opponent's best mod onto this arm.

cards.name: Pressure Drop
cards.text: +1 Glitch on the target.

cards.name: Aegis Halo
cards.text: You're never Compromised: Glitch over your Stability costs 1 Power each instead.
cards.flavor: Grace isn't the absence of sin. It's the price paid gently.

cards.name: Purifying Light
cards.text: When attached, clears all hack Glitch from its augment.

cards.name: Holy Conduit
cards.text: +2 more Power if its augment has no Glitch.

cards.name: Pacifist Protocol
cards.text: Target an arm: it counts 0 Power.

cards.name: Halo Generator
cards.text: Its augment can't be targeted by hacks.
cards.flavor: Nothing touches what it shines on.

cards.name: Hive Core
cards.text: Holds 4 mods instead of 2.

cards.name: Parasitic Infection
cards.text: The opponent loses 1 Stability, plus 1 for each Broodmother's Clutch card you have in play.

cards.name: Swarm Arm
cards.text: +1 Power for each other Broodmother's Clutch card you have in play.

cards.name: Bio-Rally
cards.text: +1 more Power on a torso.
cards.flavor: The heart beats for the hive.

cards.name: Acid Spit
cards.text: Destroy the opponent's 2 best mods.

cards.name: Gestation Pod
cards.text: +6 Power if nobody called the showdown.

cards.name: Symbiotic Link
cards.flavor: It helps. It wants to help.

cards.name: Drone Swarm
cards.text: At the showdown, the opponent gains 1 Glitch for each empty part slot.

cards.name: The Broodmother
cards.text: +2 Power for each other Broodmother's Clutch card you have in play.

cards.name: Mind-Hack Transmitter
cards.text: +1 Glitch on the target, plus 1 for each mod the opponent has.

cards.name: Synaptic Overdrive
cards.text: When installed, the opponent discards a random card.

cards.name: Memory Wipe
cards.text: The target augment loses its effect.

cards.name: Bypass Relay
cards.text: Glitch from your mods counts against the opponent instead of you.

cards.name: Hijacked Feed
cards.text: Swap heads with the opponent, mods and all.

cards.name: Sensory Deprivation
cards.text: The opponent can't play mods for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Logic Bomb
cards.text: +4 Glitch on the target if the opponent has no Glitch, otherwise +1.

cards.name: Doomsday Engine
cards.flavor: It will end everything. Including you.

cards.name: Omega Protocol
cards.text: +2 Power for each mod you have in play.

cards.name: Final Countdown
cards.text: Only on your 6th turn.

cards.name: Event Horizon
cards.text: Destroy every mod in play, yours too.

cards.name: Fatal Strike
cards.text: The opponent loses 2 from their final score.
cards.flavor: It was always going to end like this.

cards.name: Null Field
cards.text: The target's printed Power counts 0. Its mods still count.

cards.name: Destiny Weaver
cards.flavor: It has seen how this ends.

cards.name: The Last Word
cards.text: +3 Power if installed on your 6th turn or later.

cards.name: Empyrean Frame
cards.text: Your mods can't be destroyed, moved or stolen.
cards.flavor: Nothing given here is taken back.

cards.name: The Golden Rule
cards.text: +1 Power on this head each time you play a hack.

cards.name: Celestial Siphon
cards.text: When attached, draw a card.

cards.name: Over-Ray Visor
cards.text: +1 Power for each card you've drawn from card effects.
cards.flavor: Sees what's coming. All of it.

cards.name: Transcendent Plating
cards.flavor: Lighter than it has any right to be.

cards.name: God-Tier Processor
cards.text: Counts as two mods.

cards.name: Karmic Rebound
cards.text: +1 Glitch on the target. If the opponent is Compromised, draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Aetheric Uplink
cards.text: You draw 2 cards; the opponent draws 1.

cards.name: Apotheosis
cards.text: Your Stability counts double.

cards.name: Point of No Return
cards.text: When installed, take 3 more actions this turn. You lose a later turn.
cards.flavor: Past the edge, there's only forward.

cards.name: Unified Field
cards.text: Mods on your torso also apply to your other augments.

cards.name: Accretion Disk
cards.text: +1 Power for each card in your hand.

cards.name: Spaghettification
cards.text: Move all the opponent's mods onto the target. It then counts 0 Power.

cards.name: Time Dilation
cards.text: On your 5th and 6th turns, draw an extra card.

cards.name: Collapse State
cards.text: The target's printed Power counts 0. Its mods still count.

cards.name: Gravity Crush
cards.text: +3 Glitch on the target.

cards.name: Singularity Core
cards.text: + the printed Power of the opponent's strongest augment.

cards.name: Recursive Strike
cards.text: When installed, play another card this turn.

cards.name: Infinite Loop
cards.text: +2 Power for each hack played on you.

cards.name: Glitch in the Matrix
cards.text: Swap your worst mod for the opponent's best one.

cards.name: Reboot Protocol
cards.text: The opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 3.
cards.flavor: Have you tried turning it off and on?

cards.name: Echo Chamber
cards.text: +1 Power on this head each time you attach a mod.

cards.name: Iterative Process
cards.text: +1 Power for each mod you have in play.

cards.name: Cached Memory
cards.text: When attached, draw a card.

cards.name: Stack Overflow
cards.text: The opponent discards a random card.

cards.name: System Restore
cards.flavor: Back to the last good state.

cards.name: Ouroboros
cards.text: At the showdown, your strongest augment counts twice.
